# The top-level keys of a Bounded Context view.yaml, in the order the generator
# emits them. One per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# The set is FIXED, not conditional: a Bounded Context that declares no source
# selection and no repositories still gets those keys, holding empty lists. The
# alternative -- omit what the document did not populate -- asks every reader to
# tell "this team has no access failures" from "this view is older than the key",
# and those need different responses.
#
# The ORDER is part of it too. view.yaml is compared byte for byte by
# `scripts/generate.sh --check`, so a reordering is a change to every committed
# view in every documents root, and a change of that size should be argued for in
# a spec rather than arrived at by editing a jq program.
#
# tests/generate.test.sh compares this list against the generated view's keys in
# sequence, so adding a key here without adding it to scripts/lib/render.jq fails,
# and so does the reverse.

view_contract
kind
id
release
identity
organizations
extends
source_selection
systems
unreferenced_systems
repositories
anchors
outputs
limitations
access_failures
provenance
